results.name: A genuinely fresh guest can create an entry without a prior identity round-trip (no 401)
Entry starts at version 1, status draft (server-assigned, never client-supplied)
First draft save succeeds and creates version 2
Reloading the entry shows the real saved current version (server-persisted, not client-cached)
Reload rehydrates the real saved presentation payload
A retried save with the same idempotency key returns the SAME version, never creates a duplicate
Exactly 2 real version rows exist after the retry (initial + one real edit, not three)
A save carrying an outdated expectedVersion is rejected with a real conflict (409 stale_version), never silently overwritten
Of two concurrent saves both claiming the same expectedVersion, exactly one succeeds and the other is honestly told it lost the race (never both silently accepted, never a crash)
Submitting with missing required components is rejected (server decides completeness, never the client)
A draft with all required components saves successfully
A complete, valid submission is accepted (server-computed eligibility, never client-decided)
A retried submit with the same idempotency key returns the SAME real submission, never a second row
Exactly one real submission row exists in the database (UNIQUE(entry_id) is genuinely enforced)
Two concurrent submit requests (two-tab race) both succeed but resolve to the SAME real submission (no duplicate, no crash)
The two-tab submit race produced exactly one real database row
All four canonical event types were emitted (golden_box_draft_created/_updated/_submission_requested/_submitted)
The canonical golden_box_submitted event carries a real ruleVersion and entryId
A different guest is not treated as the entrant for another guest's entry (server-resolved visibility, never client-asserted)
A non-owner never receives the real presentation payload/components for a private entry
Two independent fetches under the same identity return identical entry state (no per-device drift)
A real account is created on the same cookie jar as the guest
Guest-to-account conversion succeeds
Conversion reports a real Golden Box entry transferred (found-and-fixed gap — entry_id continuity was previously broken)
After conversion, creating/fetching an entry for the same competition under the account identity returns the TRANSFERRED entry (already submitted), not a fresh draft
The transferred entry's draft history (components) survived conversion
